intent: Add the missing production verifier runner for read-only SADHANA candidates. It must bind one exact completed owner output to a distinct roster-admitted model-family verifier, durably record verifier execution identity, lifecycle, provider truth, and a mission_verifier_result receipt, then emit an IndependentAcceptance consumable by the existing campaign verifier. Same-agent or same-family verification, foreign candidates, malformed verdicts, concurrent/replayed calls, fallback to the producer family, and provider failures must fail closed without semantic acceptance.

negative_controls.name: verifier-fail-closed-controls
negative_controls.command: /Users/dhyana/dharma_swarm/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_mission_control_verifier.py -k 'same_family or replay or foreign or malformed or fallback or provider_failure or concurrent'

interface_mismatches: The existing verify command consumes IndependentAcceptance but no production path creates the required verifier identity and evidence.
Test fixtures can synthesize mission_verifier_result rows directly; live acceptance must instead bind an actual governed provider response.
Roster membership is only capacity. The verifier must prove a distinct actual served family and cannot inherit producer authority.
The verifier is inference-only and writes evidence records, never task artifacts, workspaces, tools, or external publications.
honest_blockers: A model verdict is independent evidence, not an objective oracle; rejection and BLOCKED remain valid outcomes.
The actual served model can differ from the requested seat because the provider may fall back; a producer-family fallback must not be accepted.
This runner cannot accept a candidate whose producer provider/model evidence is missing or outside its durable execution window.
No live accepted canary exists until this runner is deployed and an exact candidate is independently evaluated.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the new verifier module, CLI, tests, and packet. Existing candidate production, campaign status, and verify ingestion remain unchanged; no acceptance receipts are removed.
